componentImpact.summary: The app window always restarts. A Core whose build matches this update keeps running and is reconnected. Only a mismatched Core is replaced. Restarting the window itself does not stop terminals owned by Terminal Core. Replacement reconnects to the new Core and is not a zero-interruption swap.
componentImpact.guiRestart: restarts with the app window. That relaunch does not stop a Core-owned terminal.
componentImpact.coreRestart: is checked by build identity. It is replaced and the app reconnects only if the identity differs. This is not a zero-interruption swap.
componentImpact.deferIfActive: is checked by build identity. If it differs, replacement waits while a terminal is active and proceeds when no terminal is active. The app reconnects afterward; this is not a zero-interruption swap.
componentImpact.deferGeneric: waits while it is in use, then the app reconnects. This is not a zero-interruption swap.
componentImpact.unsupported: is not supported on this platform
componentImpact.unavailable: Component metadata is unavailable; Core compatibility will be checked conservatively.

installSemantics.ptySurvivesGui: Restarting the app window itself does not stop terminals owned by Terminal Core.
installSemantics.unavailable: Component metadata is unavailable, so Core compatibility will be checked conservatively.
installSemantics.coreAdopt: Kept and reconnected because the build matches: {{components}}.
installSemantics.coreRestart: Build identity is checked for {{components}}. A Core is replaced only if its identity differs, then the app reconnects.
installSemantics.terminalDefer: Terminal Core build identity is checked. If it differs, replacement waits while a terminal is active.
installSemantics.terminalReplaceIdle: Terminal Core build identity is checked. If it differs, no terminal is active, so it can be replaced and the app can reconnect now.
installSemantics.terminalRestartActive: Terminal Core build identity is checked. If it differs, immediate replacement may stop the terminals it owns instead of waiting.
installSemantics.deferGeneric: {{components}} wait while they are in use. The app reconnects afterward. This is not a zero-interruption swap.
installSemantics.unsupported: {{components}} cannot be updated on this platform.
installSemantics.reconnect: A replaced Core is reconnected. This is not a zero-interruption swap.

reconciliation.deferred: Saved update plan: replacement is waiting because a terminal is still active. Restarting the app window does not stop that terminal.
reconciliation.deferredComponents: Saved update plan: replacement of {{components}} is waiting because a terminal is still active. Restarting the app window does not stop that terminal.
reconciliation.failed: Saved update plan failed. Review the error, then check again.
reconciliation.reconciling: Saved update plan: components are reconnecting. This is not a zero-interruption swap.
reconciliation.completed: Saved update plan finished. Matching Cores stayed running and were reconnected.

updates.downloaded: Version {{version}} has been downloaded. Installing restarts the app window. Terminals owned by Terminal Core keep running unless that Core itself is replaced.
updates.installWithTerminals: Se will install version {{version}} and restart the app window. Restarting the window itself does not stop terminals owned by Terminal Core. A mismatched Terminal Core waits only while a terminal is active. Continue?
updates.installWithoutTerminals: Se will install version {{version}} and restart the app window. No terminal is active. Continue?
updates.safeRestartHint: The update plan is saved before the app window restarts. That relaunch does not stop terminals owned by Terminal Core. A mismatched Terminal Core waits only while a terminal is active. Reconnecting after a replacement is not a zero-interruption swap.
updates.skippedDescription: You will not be notified about this version again.
updates.reminderDescription: We will remind you about the update tomorrow.
